degree_rationale: Treats the wheel/prochos before the King of Glory as the cosmic mechanism by which all archonic motion is registered, sealed, and judged. This is mechanism — HOW the cosmic gear works to display the moves of every power.
direction_rationale: Marks the descent into the spiritual degree at its eastern beginning: the originating mechanism of cosmic registration. Generative — the wheel as primal gear from which all process proceeds.
grand_man_function: Spiritual gear at origin — the mechanism that registers cosmic motion (like brain's primary processor).
title: The Wheel that exists before the King of Glory
